verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for a payments platform, for example scheduled transfers or automated workflows. The evidence only shows recurring billing: payment plans for subscriptions and recurring payments through payment links. That is an adjacent, domain-specific billing feature, not a general capability to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. No scheduler, cron, or workflow-automation feature is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
